title: Right Roos normalization before the quotient formula
statement: Before the explicit nested quotient formula, the normalized scalar realization and pullback model compose with the fixed Roos coordinate map to the ordinary scalar/pullback chain through the completion inverse. This normalization equation uses the coherent presentation and q but does not use the separate quotient-generator formula hq.

source.place: Tags 06YY (derived tensor), 07A4 (pullback and tensor), 0941 (derived limits); the normalization part of step 8 of lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence.

proof.text: Instantiate the normalized pullback model ME and the normalized scalar model SX on a flat-term K-flat representative of the coherent presentation. Transpose their counit equations through pullbackReduction and the scalar cochain counit; naturality of the Roos bridge gives the displayed equation before applying the separate quotient formula.

Transport the resulting equation along eP and the ordinary derived scalar/pullback comparison. The resulting tail is the explicit ordinary scalar/pullback chain ending in the finite-level map induced by q.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; normalized right route before the quotient formula.
